path = Path('tests/oauth2/rfc8628/test_server.py')
text = path.read_text()
text = text.replace(
    '            request_validator=mock.MagicMock(spec=RequestValidator),\n',
    '            request_validator=self.request_validator,\n',
    1,
)
marker = '    @mock.patch("oauthlib.oauth2.rfc8628.endpoints.device_authorization.generate_token")\n'
tests = '''    def test_constructor_defaults(self):
        self.assertIs(self.endpoint.request_validator, self.request_validator)
        self.assertEqual(self.endpoint.verification_uri, self.verification_uri)
        self.assertEqual(self.endpoint.expires_in, 1800)
        self.assertIsNone(self.endpoint.interval)
        self.assertTrue(self.endpoint.available)
        self.assertFalse(self.endpoint.catch_errors)
        self.assertIsNone(self.endpoint.valid_request_methods)

    def test_constructor_parameters(self):
        verification_uri = "https://example.com/device"
        endpoint = DeviceAuthorizationEndpoint(
            request_validator=self.request_validator,
            verification_uri=verification_uri,
            expires_in=600,
            interval=5,
        )
        self.assertIs(endpoint.request_validator, self.request_validator)
        self.assertEqual(endpoint.verification_uri, verification_uri)
        self.assertEqual(endpoint.expires_in, 600)
        self.assertEqual(endpoint.interval, 5)

        _, body, status_code = endpoint.create_device_authorization_response(
            *self.response_payload()
        )
        self.assertEqual(status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(body["verification_uri"], verification_uri)
        self.assertEqual(body["expires_in"], 600)
        self.assertEqual(body["interval"], 5)
        self.request_validator.validate_client_id.assert_called_once()
        self.request_validator.authenticate_client.assert_called_once()

    def test_constructor_positional_parameters_with_zero_values(self):
        endpoint = DeviceAuthorizationEndpoint(
            self.request_validator, self.verification_uri, 0, 0
        )
        self.assertIs(endpoint.request_validator, self.request_validator)
        self.assertEqual(endpoint.verification_uri, self.verification_uri)
        self.assertEqual(endpoint.expires_in, 0)
        self.assertEqual(endpoint.interval, 0)

        _, body, status_code = endpoint.create_device_authorization_response(
            *self.response_payload()
        )
        self.assertEqual(status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(body["expires_in"], 0)
        self.assertEqual(body["interval"], 0)

'''
assert marker in text
text = text.replace(marker, tests + marker, 1)
path.write_text(text)
